# Transformer check-sync-data — regpas & medrec (his-data-integration → his-backend)

**Goal:** a consumer of the Primaya HIS Transformer API can page `regpas` and `medrec` in discharge order, resume safely from the last record's key (RegID / MEDRECID) and trust the poli, doctor and diagnosis fields (HISv3-IMPROVEMENT-00145).

**Docs:** test doc [transformer-sync-testing.md](../../transformer-sync-testing.md) · scenarios [transformer-sync-scenarios.md](../../transformer-sync-scenarios.md) · module features: [module catalogue](../../modules/README.md) (linked on every story).

Surface under test: `POST /api/v1/transformer/check-sync-data/{regpas|medrec}` of a local his-data-integration build wired to the staging DB (his-backend [#4818](https://github.com/developersismedika/his-backend/pull/4818), docs [#120](https://github.com/developersismedika/his-data-integration/pull/120)). Expected order and fields come from independent read-only SELECTs on staging (`transformer.db.ts`). Needs `HIS_DATA_INTEGRATION_URL`, the QA api_client the harness seeds (`seed-apiclients.py --repo hdi`) and the staging DB credential file; the specs skip with a reason otherwise. Read-only: nothing is written.

## User stories

Full acceptance criteria and the scenarios with real staging data: [../transformer-sync-scenarios.md](../../transformer-sync-scenarios.md).

- **US-TRSYNC-01** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — As a Transformer consumer I want to page `regpas` in discharge order and resume from the RegID I last processed, so that I never re-read or miss a registration after a restart.
- **US-TRSYNC-02** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — As a Transformer consumer I want to page `medrec` in discharge order and resume from the MEDRECID I last processed, so that every patient master change reaches me exactly once.
- **US-TRSYNC-03** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — As a Transformer consumer I want `regpas` to carry the correct second poli, its doctor and the DPJP poli's diagnosis, so that my copy of the registration matches what the hospital recorded.
- **US-TRSYNC-04** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — As a Transformer consumer I want `_sync` and `_sync_date` of `medrec` to stay at their defaults, so that legacy sync markers never influence what I receive.
- **US-TRSYNC-05** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — As an integration engineer I want a predictable request contract (limit, `X-Timezone`, `cursor_value`, tail page, credentials), so that a bad request is rejected clearly instead of returning wrong data.
- **US-TRSYNC-06** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — As a QA lead I want the open points (demographic edits, duplicate RegID, fallback keys, production-size performance) tracked as cases, so that nothing is silently untested.
